stages.title: Scope and design delivery
stages.acceptance: Four design documents plus checksum/source audit; no execution or human acceptance implied

stages.title: Evaluator qualification
stages.acceptance: Useful known-label nomination and independently assessed evaluator-change benefit

stages.title: Fair generator comparison
stages.acceptance: Paired seeds, nondegenerate binary, equal support/raw budgets and complete failure denominators

stages.title: Independent physical decision
stages.acceptance: Common-protocol replicated transport, parameter/control/convergence gates and uncertainty

stages.title: One justified extension
stages.acceptance: DP/formulation mechanism OR sealed independent feedback; otherwise stop expansion

decisions.recommendation: PCFF+ coverage/run-0, common protocol and convergence before MD
